summary: Targeted retest of lesson-content bug fix. Backend GET /api/curriculum returns all 33 quests with lesson arrays of 3+ real teaching blocks — 0 quests contain 'Welcome, Explorer' placeholder. Spot-checked trial grading with lesson-derived answers: t1-q1 {a:'Call the meeting to order', b:'Agenda', c:'The official written record'} → 100% mastery; t3-q6 Caesar {a:'Shifting each letter by a fixed amount', b:'B', c:'Each letter with another symbol/letter'} → 100%; t4-q3 ASCII/Binary {a:'0 and 1', b:'2', c:'Maps characters to numbers'} → 100%. Lessons genuinely teach the trial answers. UI: /quest/t1-q1 'The Lesson' section renders real content — H3 subheadings ('Why meeting structure matters', 'The order of business', 'Key roles & records'), 6 bulleted rows, bold terms styled (Call to order, Approve the agenda, Adjourn, chair (president), minutes). No placeholder text present. Full quest flow regression: trial radio options select, reflection input works, submit fires POST /api/trials/t1-q1/submit and shows Result dialog ('Territory Conquered!', 100%, 3/3), Copilot floating button visible. No console/page errors during flow.
critical_code_review_comments: curriculum.py: LESSONS dict is well-structured with 33 keys matching quest ids; _lesson_for() gracefully falls back to [title, sdesc] if a key is missing (defensive).

QuestView.jsx: LessonContent + renderInline correctly parse '## ' → h3, '- ' → bulleted row, and inline **bold** / `code` / *em*. Clean, readable, and safe (uses string.startsWith/slice, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML).

success_rate.backend: 100% (33/33 quests have real lesson content; 3/3 spot-checked trials grade 100% with lesson-derived answers)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (lesson renders real content; full trial flow, dialog, copilot work)
